app.name: FarmGuard
app.tagline: Smart when online, helpful when offline, always in your language.

auth.name: Your name
auth.farmerHint: I grow crops and want advice
auth.helperHint: I help a farmer in my family use the app

dashboard.completeProfile: Complete your farm profile to get personalised advice.
dashboard.linkCodeHint: Share this code with a family member so they can help you.
dashboard.selectFarmer: Select a farmer you help from the Family page.

farm.title: My Farm
farm.locationHint: Tap on the map to mark your field, or use GPS.
farm.viewOnly: You have view-only access to this farm.

msg.title: Quick Messages
msg.intro: Tap a message. It writes itself in the right language — then tap WhatsApp or SMS and press Send.
msg.tapSendHint: WhatsApp/SMS opens with this message ready — just press Send.

contacts.title: My Contacts
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Add family, Krishi officer or supplier.

family.shareCodeHint: Give this code to your son, daughter or relative. They enter it in their FarmGuard app to help you.
family.linkFarmerHint: Ask the farmer for the 6-digit code shown in their app.
family.noHelpers: No helpers linked yet. Share your code with a family member.
family.noFarmers: You are not helping anyone yet. Enter a farmer's code above.
family.helpSent: Your family was notified ({{count}}). Also send on WhatsApp:

weather.needLocation: Mark your farm location to get weather and irrigation advice.
weather.noData: Weather is not available right now and nothing is saved yet. Try again when online.

reason.rain_expected: Rain is likely soon ({{rain}}% chance) — let the rain water your field.
reason.soil_dry: Soil is dry: only {{available}}% of usable water is left.
reason.high_evaporation: Hot, dry weather: your crop uses about {{et}} mm of water today.
reason.soil_moderate: Soil water is moderate ({{available}}%). Check again tomorrow.
reason.no_soil_data: Soil moisture data is not available; advice is based on weather only.
reason.rainfed_tip: Your farm is rain-fed — if you have any stored water, use it in the evening.

irrigation.setCrop: Set your current crop for better advice:
irrigation.litres: For your land: about {{today}} litres today, {{week}} litres this week.
irrigation.method: Method: FAO-56 crop water need (Kc {{kc}} × evaporation) + modelled soil moisture + rain forecast.

scan.modelLoading: Loading the disease model… (first time ~25 MB, then saved on this phone)
scan.modelOffline: Model saved on this phone — scanning works without internet.
scan.pending: {{count}} scan(s) saved on phone, will sync when online
scan.photoTips: Tip: photograph ONE leaf, close-up, in daylight, on a plain background, without shadow.
scan.rejected: This does not look like a single crop leaf the model knows. Please take a clearer photo of one leaf.
scan.unsure: Not sure ({{pct}}%). The crop or disease may not be one the model knows.
scan.attribution: Model: plant-disease-dinov2-small by Rodayna Emad (CC BY-SA 4.0), trained on PlantVillage (Hughes & Salathé). Supports 14 crops: apple, blueberry, cherry, maize, grape, orange, peach, capsicum, potato, raspberry, soybean, squash, strawberry, tomato.

radar.intro: Every leaf scan in your area helps everyone. When several nearby farms report the same disease and the weather favours its spread, farmers growing that crop are warned early.
radar.analyzed: Analysis done: {{outbreaks}} cluster(s) found, {{alerts}} new alert(s) sent.
radar.demoBanner: This map contains DEMO DATA (fake nearby farms) for demonstration. Real reports are shown the same way.
radar.noneNear: No disease outbreaks reported near your farm.
radar.yourCrop: This is your crop — check your leaves today.
radar.weatherOnly: Weather risk for your crop (next 3 days)
radar.weatherOnlyHint: Based only on the forecast — works even when no one nearby has reported anything.
radar.cropNotSupported: Set a supported crop (e.g. potato, tomato, maize, grape, apple) on My Farm to see disease weather risk.
radar.demoHint: Adds fake scans from nearby farms, clearly marked as DEMO DATA, then runs the analysis. Remove them anytime.
radar.privacy: Privacy: only the disease result and a location rounded to about 1 km are shared — never your photo, name or exact field. You can delete any scan.
radar.sharedNote: Shared anonymously with the Village Disease Radar to warn nearby farmers.

crop.soilAuto: Not sure? Choose 'Not sure' — we estimate your soil from satellite soil maps (SoilGrids) for your location.
crop.cardHint: Have a Soil Health Card? Take a photo or type the values — this gives the most accurate advice.
crop.inputsUsed: Based on: {{season}}, avg {{t}}°C, rain {{rain}} mm, pH {{ph}}, {{soil}} soil.
crop.noneSuitable: No crop fits these conditions. Try another season or water source.
crop.tipNote: General guidance — get exact doses from your Soil Health Card / KVK.

tip.acidic: Soil is acidic (pH {{v}}): apply agricultural lime as advised.
tip.alkaline: Soil is alkaline (pH {{v}}): add gypsum and organic manure.
tip.low_n: Nitrogen is low ({{v}} kg/ha): use urea in split doses or grow a legume.
tip.low_p: Phosphorus is low ({{v}} kg/ha): apply DAP / SSP at sowing.
tip.low_k: Potassium is low ({{v}} kg/ha): apply MOP (potash).
tip.low_oc: Organic carbon is low ({{v}}%): add compost / FYM, keep crop residue.

reason.water_drip_high: Needs a lot of water even with drip
reason.soil_ok: Soil type is not the best
reason.legume_after_cereal: Pulse after cereal restores soil nitrogen
reason.same_family: Same crop family as last time

crop.disclaimer: Advice uses crop suitability ranges (FAO ECOCROP), your soil and last year's weather. Yields, prices and costs are estimates — confirm with your KVK.

sat.intro: Free Sentinel-2 satellite images (every ~5 days, 10 m detail) show how green and well-watered your field is — often before you can see a problem.

flag.bare_or_harvested: 🟤 Very little green — field is bare, just sown or harvested.
flag.water_stress: 💧 Leaves look dry (low NDMI) — check irrigation.
flag.dropping: 📉 Greenness dropped sharply since the last image — check for disease, pests or water stress (or it was harvested).
flag.growing: 📈 Crop is growing well since the last image.
flag.patchy: ⚠️ {{pct}}% of the field area looks weak — walk to the weak patches and scan leaves.

sat.trendHint: Green band = dense healthy crop, yellow = sparse/stressed, grey = bare soil.
sat.areaHint: Yellow circle ≈ 330 m box around your marked farm point. Mark the field centre on My Farm for best results.
sat.estimateText: No clear satellite image — estimate from soil moisture and the next 7 days (rain {{rain}} mm vs evaporation {{et}} mm).
sat.estimateNote: This is an estimate, not a satellite measurement.
sat.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed via Microsoft Planetary Computer. Base map imagery © Esri.

assistant.placeholder: Ask about irrigation, weather, crops, disease, schemes…
assistant.disclaimer: Answers use your farm data and built-in guidance (or AI when enabled). For pesticides and loans, confirm with your KVK / bank.

schemes.intro: Main government schemes for farmers. Tap a scheme for eligibility and how to apply.
schemes.note: Information last checked {{date}}. Amounts and rules change — always confirm on the official website.

intro.equipment: Rent tractors and machines from farmers near you — or earn by renting out yours.
intro.waste: Sell or give straw, husk and stalks for fodder, biogas or mushrooms — instead of burning them.

market.empty: Nothing listed near you yet. Be the first!
market.noLocation: Set your farm location on My Farm to see distances and nearby listings.
market.privacy: Your name, village and phone number will be shown to nearby farmers so they can contact you.

server.backend: FarmGuard server is OFF (the "FarmGuard Backend" window was closed). Run start.bat again — your data is safe.
server.app: FarmGuard app server is OFF (the "FarmGuard Frontend" window was closed). Run start.bat again, then reload this page.
server.offline: No internet on this device. Disease Scan and saved data still work.

pwa.offline: You are offline — showing saved data. Disease Scan still works.
pwa.installHint: Install FarmGuard on your phone for quick, offline access.

status.title: System Status
status.intro: Every feature works in two modes. LIVE uses an online service; FALLBACK uses built-in data so the app never breaks.
status.forced: Force-fallback is ON (all services in fallback).
